purpose: Turn the seven remaining root-biconditional semantic obligations into an immutable machine-readable proof ledger, classifying existing repository evidence without mistaking finite replay or implementation for a general semantic theorem.

classification_vocabulary.GENERAL_SEMANTIC_THEOREM_ESTABLISHED: A machine-bound preservation/reflection theorem over the declared semantic domain, not merely finite fixtures.
classification_vocabulary.FINITE_INSTANCE_SEMANTIC_CROSSCHECK_ESTA: Exhaustive semantic agreement only on a frozen finite subject.
classification_vocabulary.TRAJECTORY_ALGEBRA_ESTABLISHED: The trajectory operation/relation is independently replayed, but its correspondence to partial layouts is not yet established generally.
classification_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTATION_AND_FINITE_REPLAY_ONLY: Code and bounded replay exist; no general semantic reflection theorem is machine-bound.

obligations.required_theorem: The canonical leaf generator and its up_k closure represent exactly the one-factor width<=k partial layouts at the leaf boundary.
Boundary expansion preserves and reflects represented partial-layout semantics with no omission or invention.

Every compatible semantic interleaving corresponds to an allowed ordinary H/V join path and every allowed ordinary H/V join path represents a compatible semantic interleaving under the corrected path domain.
Shrink projection and lambda correction preserve and reflect the exact parent-boundary partial-layout semantics.
Every refinement rejected by final post-shrink compact width>k is semantically infeasible at cap k, and every feasible parent semantic state has at least one successful refinement.
Duplicate deletion, preorder minimization, and up_k closure preserve and reflect the represented partial-layout language, not only the finite trajectory closure.
At empty boundary the represented width<=k semantic language is exactly the complete whole-factor layout language.

known_negative_evidence.historical_root_false_positive: The historical ordinary Delannoy join domain admitted diagonal join steps and produced false accepting root states on the six-factor fixture while exhaustive layouts had minimum width 2.
known_negative_evidence.corrected_path_domain: The corrected root refinement freezes ordinary join steps to H/V only; diagonal remains available only to the B2 extension preorder.
known_negative_evidence.meaning: The historical obstruction motivates but does not itself prove the corrected semantic reflection theorem.

verifier_obligations: INV01 exact source blob and admitted finite-pointwise receipt bindings
INV02 exactly seven obligations with stable identifiers
INV03 every obligation has a required theorem, evidence ceiling, and next receipt
INV04 no evidence ceiling may equal GENERAL_SEMANTIC_THEOREM_ESTABLISHED without a bound theorem receipt
INV05 B1 and B2 evidence may not be promoted from trajectory algebra to semantic language theorem
INV06 corrected ordinary join domain must be H/V only and distinct from B2 diagonal-enabled extension preorder
INV07 historical reflection obstruction must remain negative evidence, not positive theorem evidence
INV08 finite pointwise root result may support only finite-instance evidence ceilings
INV09 all seven next receipts remain individually required
INV10 ledger must be deterministic and byte-identical across source presentation order
INV11 digest-repaired tamper suite must reject evidence-ceiling or boundary promotion
